@upstash/context7-sdk@0.7.1 Stable2026-11-16T14:53:49Z

Patch Changes

  • 4087030: The SDK now reads a JSON response when the server sends a mixed-case Content-Type, such as Application/Json. Before, searchLibrary() threw a TypeError on such a response. Lookalike types such as application/jsonp stay on the text path.

View release →

@upstash/context7-mcp@4.7.1 Stable2026-11-16T14:53:46Z

Patch Changes

  • d80a84c: While a library's source is being indexed, ctx7 code and query-code now say to call again for up to 3 minutes instead of at most twice: a first index usually takes 1 to 3 minutes. When the server message already gives this rule, the clients no longer repeat it.
  • d53d88d: The research preview is now called experimental tools. Each signed-in user picks the experimental tools to list at Settings > MCP Tools in the Context7 dashboard, where "All experimental tools" also includes tools added later. The old flags (--research-preview, CONTEXT7_RESEARCH_PREVIEW=1, ?research_preview=1) and the new --experimental, CONTEXT7_EXPERIMENTAL=1 and ?experimental=1 still turn on every experimental tool.
  • 6e469e3: Update @modelcontextprotocol/node to 2.1.2 and @modelcontextprotocol/server to 2.4.0, which bring in security fixes for @hono/node-server, hono and their dependencies.
  • 0718ba8: query-code no longer greps a docs-style query of several words, which matched nothing: it answers with a correction that pattern is a regex matched within one line. A one-word query, or a phrase with fixed_strings, still works as the pattern. pattern now takes up to 1000 characters, like the server.
  • c5e26f6: Describe query-code references as name matches, resolved only for libraries with a SCIP index

View release →

ctx7@0.12.0 Stable2026-11-16T14:53:43Z

Minor Changes

  • 6515def: Add ctx7 get-upgrade-guide <libraryId> <fromVersion> [toVersion], the CLI counterpart of the get-upgrade-guide MCP tool. It prints the guide between two versions of a library, with --page for long guides and --json, and exits with code 75 while the guide is being prepared.

Patch Changes

  • 7d8781b: ctx7 login and ctx7 whoami no longer hang on a stalled host: the identity check times out after 30 s, and an OAuth answer whose body stalls after the headers ends with the same clear timeout message as a stalled connection.
  • 76511d5: ctx7 API calls now time out instead of hanging on a stalled connection: ctx7 code after 70 s (the server waits up to 40 s for a first index), the other commands after 60 s, also when the answer stalls after its headers. Login and token refresh calls time out after 30 s, and the usage ping after 3 s, so a stalled host no longer keeps ctx7 running. A timeout prints a clear error and exits 1.
  • 8fc3f6d: When stdout is piped, ctx7 writes warnings, errors and their hints to stderr, so ctx7 code ... | grep x still shows the "being indexed" notice and errors. --json output stays on stdout.
  • d80a84c: While a library's source is being indexed, ctx7 code and query-code now say to call again for up to 3 minutes instead of at most twice: a first index usually takes 1 to 3 minutes. When the server message already gives this rule, the clients no longer repeat it.

[2.12.5]

Bug Fixes

  • 9a66eab83 (#16478 by @lazerg) Fix a Windows signCommand that replaces the main binary (for example by writing a signed copy and renaming it over the original) failing with Access is denied. (os error 5). The bundler no longer keeps the main binary open after copying it.
  • 5edd31c8a (#16506 by @TakahiroNago) Fix the MSI installer re-creating the desktop shortcut on every update even after the user deleted it. The shortcut is now only re-created during an upgrade if it still exists, matching the NSIS installer.
  • 8d3efdeea (#16060 by @Raaif-Yousuf) Fix NSIS and MSI bundling failing with Unable to start child process, error 0x2 when running as the Windows SYSTEM account, for example on a CI runner installed as a service. When the cache directory is inside C:\Windows\System32, where WOW64 file system redirection hides the downloaded tools from the 32-bit NSIS and WiX executables, the bundler now stores them in the project output directory instead. If the tools directory would still be inside System32, for example because the project is, bundling now fails early with an error that explains why.
  • 31f29e197 (#16436 by @b84330808) Fix the builtin dev server serving index.html instead of files whose names contain spaces or non-ASCII characters, such as my font.woff2.
  • 7b568e9c0 (#16521 by @1AbdullahButt) Fix tauri migrate failing to parse the app's Cargo.toml when its package version is inherited from the workspace (version.workspace = true).
  • 71b668096 (#14712 by @onebytegone) Fix iOS export failing with "Couldn't load -exportOptionsPlist" error when running tauri ios run.
  • 7facf4f23 (#16398 by @ashokram-si) Fix tauri dev not watching the app at all when its .taurignore contains a pattern like /* that matches every entry at the top level, even if other entries are re-included with ! negations. Watch folders are now always watched; ignore rules apply to their entries and to change events.
  • 9a010f444 (#15773 by @yingyanzhitong) Read manual iOS signing certificates and provisioning profiles from the Xcode project when generating export options, without overriding the values configured in ExportOptions.plist. Provisioning profiles from ExportOptions.plist (such as the ones for app extensions) are now kept when merging.
  • 7e39750cf Update the CLI's locked Zstandard dependencies to address RUSTSEC-2026-0391 and RUSTSEC-2026-0395 through RUSTSEC-2026-0406, plus RUSTSEC-2026-0410.

Dependencies

  • Upgraded to tauri-bundler@2.10.5
  • Upgraded to tauri-utils@2.10.3

@tauri-apps/cli-v2.12.5@tauri-apps/cli v2.12.5 Stable2026-11-16T12:43:52Z

[2.12.5]

Bug Fixes

  • 9a66eab83 (#16478 by @lazerg) Fix a Windows signCommand that replaces the main binary (for example by writing a signed copy and renaming it over the original) failing with Access is denied. (os error 5). The bundler no longer keeps the main binary open after copying it.
  • 5edd31c8a (#16506 by @TakahiroNago) Fix the MSI installer re-creating the desktop shortcut on every update even after the user deleted it. The shortcut is now only re-created during an upgrade if it still exists, matching the NSIS installer.
  • 8d3efdeea (#16060 by @Raaif-Yousuf) Fix NSIS and MSI bundling failing with Unable to start child process, error 0x2 when running as the Windows SYSTEM account, for example on a CI runner installed as a service. When the cache directory is inside C:\Windows\System32, where WOW64 file system redirection hides the downloaded tools from the 32-bit NSIS and WiX executables, the bundler now stores them in the project output directory instead. If the tools directory would still be inside System32, for example because the project is, bundling now fails early with an error that explains why.
  • 31f29e197 (#16436 by @b84330808) Fix the builtin dev server serving index.html instead of files whose names contain spaces or non-ASCII characters, such as my font.woff2.
  • 7b568e9c0 (#16521 by @1AbdullahButt) Fix tauri migrate failing to parse the app's Cargo.toml when its package version is inherited from the workspace (version.workspace = true).
  • 71b668096 (#14712 by @onebytegone) Fix iOS export failing with "Couldn't load -exportOptionsPlist" error when running tauri ios run.
  • 7facf4f23 (#16398 by @ashokram-si) Fix tauri dev not watching the app at all when its .taurignore contains a pattern like /* that matches every entry at the top level, even if other entries are re-included with ! negations. Watch folders are now always watched; ignore rules apply to their entries and to change events.
  • 9a010f444 (#15773 by @yingyanzhitong) Read manual iOS signing certificates and provisioning profiles from the Xcode project when generating export options, without overriding the values configured in ExportOptions.plist. Provisioning profiles from ExportOptions.plist (such as the ones for app extensions) are now kept when merging.
  • 7e39750cf Update the CLI's locked Zstandard dependencies to address RUSTSEC-2026-0391 and RUSTSEC-2026-0395 through RUSTSEC-2026-0406, plus RUSTSEC-2026-0410.

Dependencies

  • Upgraded to tauri-cli@2.12.5

[2.12.6]

Bug Fixes

  • eebf7c23c (#16438 by @lazerg) Fix a deadlock when emitting an event from a non-main thread with the tracing feature enabled while the main thread emits an event or looks up a webview, for example in a document title change handler.
  • ba1e205f3 (#16368 by @masonliiu) Fix a Linux session crash where every touch event near the border of an undecorated window started another resize drag. A resize drag now only starts on touch begin.
  • 3b769fbd5 (#16462 by @lazerg) On macOS, process::restart (and AppHandle::restart) no longer brings the relaunched app to the foreground, so it doesn't take focus from the app the user is working in.
  • ab1875e19 (#16376 by @Legend-Master) Preserve the original URL path without percent decoding them when proxying them on mobile dev
  • a1ea1b5e5 (#16453 by @b84330808) Keep the drive letter or UNC share of absolute bundle > resources and bundle > externalBin paths on Windows. Before, a resource on another drive than the current directory, for example D:/assets/* in a project on C:, failed with a "resource path doesn't exist" error.
  • 8d5f74c1c (#16439 by @Lorkydey) On Windows, let accessibility hit tests pass through the resize helper outside the top border of frameless windows with shadows, so screen readers can reach the window content.

[2.12.4]

Bug Fixes

  • ba1e205f3 (#16368 by @masonliiu) Fix a Linux session crash where every touch event near the border of an undecorated window started another resize drag. A resize drag now only starts on touch begin.
  • e86f1a61c (#16427 by @lazerg) Fix window.open('') being denied on macOS before reaching the on_new_window handler. An empty URL is now passed to the handler as about:blank.
  • d5e56b8fd (#16510 by @Legend-Master) Release WryWindowDispatcher::window_id early without holding the lock across the entire handlers
  • 8d5f74c1c (#16439 by @Lorkydey) On Windows, let accessibility hit tests pass through the resize helper outside the top border of frameless windows with shadows, so screen readers can reach the window content.

[2.10.5]

Enhancements

  • 6df8a2e13 (#16451 by @oyobbeb) Show a dedicated message in the NSIS installer when the running app can't be closed because the installer doesn't have permission to close it (for example when the app runs as administrator).

Bug Fixes

  • 9a66eab83 (#16478 by @lazerg) Fix a Windows signCommand that replaces the main binary (for example by writing a signed copy and renaming it over the original) failing with Access is denied. (os error 5). The bundler no longer keeps the main binary open after copying it.
  • 5edd31c8a (#16506 by @TakahiroNago) Fix the MSI installer re-creating the desktop shortcut on every update even after the user deleted it. The shortcut is now only re-created during an upgrade if it still exists, matching the NSIS installer.
  • 8d3efdeea (#16060 by @Raaif-Yousuf) Fix NSIS and MSI bundling failing with Unable to start child process, error 0x2 when running as the Windows SYSTEM account, for example on a CI runner installed as a service. When the cache directory is inside C:\Windows\System32, where WOW64 file system redirection hides the downloaded tools from the 32-bit NSIS and WiX executables, the bundler now stores them in the project output directory instead. If the tools directory would still be inside System32, for example because the project is, bundling now fails early with an error that explains why.
  • a72849807 (#16486 by @lazerg) Fix NSIS bundling on macOS and Linux deleting the cached NSIS tools and downloading nsis_tauri_utils.dll again on every build. The NSIS.exe hash check now only runs on Windows, where NSIS.exe is part of the downloaded toolset.
  • 06cc1ac43 (#16362 by @amrbashir) Fix NSIS builds using the Persian translation by using the correct language name, Farsi. Persian is still accepted as a deprecated alias.
  • 37b3be665 (#16361 by @amrbashir) Include the Hebrew language file in the NSIS installer. It was never bundled and Hebrew installers showed blank text.
  • a200fae13 (#16336 by @zarkone) Fix .rpm bundling of a SemVer pre-release version such as 1.0.0-beta.1 failing with invalid version errors. The pre-release is now written in RPM's tilde form (1.0.0~beta.1), which sorts before the release as SemVer intends. The bundle's filename is unchanged.
  • 7e39750cf Update the CLI's locked Zstandard dependencies to address RUSTSEC-2026-0391 and RUSTSEC-2026-0395 through RUSTSEC-2026-0406, plus RUSTSEC-2026-0410.

Dependencies

  • Upgraded to tauri-utils@2.10.3

[2.10.3]

Bug Fixes

  • 219a60724 (#16444 by @b84330808) Fix parsing a hex Color string panicking when it contains non-ASCII characters, for example #€€; it now returns an error. Surrounding whitespace is also trimmed when the string has no leading #.
  • c51f047e9 (#16447 by @b84330808) Match file extensions case-insensitively when guessing a MIME type, so files such as app.JS or Logo.SVG no longer get the fallback type (text/html for the tauri:// and asset:// protocols).
  • a1ea1b5e5 (#16453 by @b84330808) Keep the drive letter or UNC share of absolute bundle > resources and bundle > externalBin paths on Windows. Before, a resource on another drive than the current directory, for example D:/assets/* in a project on C:, failed with a "resource path doesn't exist" error.

Performance Improvements

  • 0e5809589 (#16402 by @johncarmack1984) Mark config::parse::parse_json and parse_json5 #[inline] so crates that don't call them no longer generate code for the Config deserializer.

cua-driver-rs-v0.52.6cua-driver-rs: v0.52.6 Prerelease2026-11-16T12:34:09Z

Cua Driver 0.52.6

Summary

This release includes 1 fix.

Fixes

  • deliver desktop click and scroll on the nested cua-compositor. (#7926) reported by @muness.

Contributors

Thanks to @muness for contributing to this release.

Install

macOS and Linux:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

Windows:

irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds, and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and uninstaller scripts.

Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest” pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned cua-driver-rs-v* releases directly.

nightly-cua-driver-rs-v0.52.4-nightly.20261116.43804048942 Prerelease2026-11-16T05:40:10Z

Cua Driver 0.52.4-nightly.20261116.43804048942 (nightly)

Automated immutable nightly built from an exact main commit. Nightlies are opt-in, may be less stable than regular releases, and never replace stable update discovery.

Source

  • Commit: e7d713b28f7a8f7102cf7b15f567efb46f300beb
  • Changes: nightly-cua-driver-rs-v0.51.3-nightly.20261115.43676355200…e7d713b28f7a

Changes

  • Fix: advise only the retry that lifts each PARTIAL TREE cut. (#7800) reported by @ymehili.
  • Fix: drop the success glyph from unconfirmed action text. (#7806) reported by @ymehili.
  • Fix: refuse a live label held by another transport with session_owned_by_other_transport. (#7811) reported by @ymehili.
  • Fix: keep each session's own snapshot of a shared window. (#7809) reported by @ymehili.
  • Feat: add deepseek-harness to mcp-config and skills install. (#7826) reported by @ymehili.
  • Fix: revive an idle-reaped named session on its owner's next call. (#7832) reported by @ymehili.
  • Fix: refuse the stale-transform probes from a client that never read the window. (#7831)
  • Fix: bind Electron apps by their runtime and name the isolated launch. (#7818) reported by @ymehili.
  • Fix: state zero-match get_window_state queries and match a|b alternatives. (#7819) reported by @ymehili.
  • Fix: cursor overlay no longer takes the front app (re-land of #7268). (#7645) Thanks @jeremiahdjordan.
  • Fix: expose snapshot identity in full window-state text. (#7844) Thanks @saariuslystoned.
  • Fix: await Wayland cursor arrival before desktop clicks. (#5613) Thanks @Jacobious52.
  • Fix: batch the macOS identity and window-scope string reads. (#7854) reported by @muness.
  • Fix: pin that the desktop lane frees before the detached window watch. (#7858)
  • Fix: skip the glide wait for a cursor turned off at runtime. (#7860) Thanks @Mohit20057; reported by @FredAmartey.
  • Fix: return a native set_value once its field settles. (#7874) reported by @muness.
  • Fix: let users admit apps past Hyprland background input quirks. (#7867) reported by @matt-shearing.
  • Fix: bind window screenshots on the nested cua-compositor. (#7890) reported by @muness.

Contributors

Thanks to @FredAmartey, @Jacobious52, @jeremiahdjordan, @matt-shearing, @Mohit20057, @muness, @saariuslystoned, @ymehili for contributing to or reporting changes in this nightly.

Exact installation

CUA_DRIVER_RS_VERSION=nightly-cua-driver-rs-v0.52.4-nightly.20261116.43804048942 /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

Cua Driver 0.52.3

Summary

This release includes 1 fix.

Fixes

  • bind window screenshots on the nested cua-compositor. (#7890) reported by @muness.

Contributors

Thanks to @muness for contributing to this release.

Install

macOS and Linux:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

Windows:

irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds, and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and uninstaller scripts.

Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest” pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned cua-driver-rs-v* releases directly.

cua-driver-rs-v0.52.1cua-driver-rs: v0.52.1 Prerelease2026-11-15T22:48:42Z

Cua Driver 0.52.1

Summary

This release includes 6 fixes.

Fixes

  • cursor overlay no longer takes the front app (re-land of #7268). (#7645) Thanks @jeremiahdjordan.
  • expose snapshot identity in full window-state text. (#7844) Thanks @saariuslystoned.
  • await Wayland cursor arrival before desktop clicks. (#5613) Thanks @Jacobious52.
  • batch the macOS identity and window-scope string reads. (#7854) reported by @muness.
  • pin that the desktop lane frees before the detached window watch. (#7858)
  • skip the glide wait for a cursor turned off at runtime. (#7860) Thanks @Mohit20057; reported by @FredAmartey.

Contributors

Thanks to @FredAmartey, @Jacobious52, @jeremiahdjordan, @Mohit20057, @muness, @saariuslystoned for contributing to this release.

Install

macOS and Linux:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

Windows:

irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds, and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and uninstaller scripts.

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest” pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned cua-driver-rs-v* releases directly.

cua-driver-rs-v0.52.0cua-driver-rs: v0.52.0 Prerelease2026-11-15T16:58:15Z

Cua Driver 0.52.0

Summary

This release adds 1 features and includes 4 fixes.

Features

  • add deepseek-harness to mcp-config and skills install. (#7826) reported by @ymehili.

Fixes

  • revive an idle-reaped named session on its owner's next call. (#7832) reported by @ymehili.
  • refuse the stale-transform probes from a client that never read the window. (#7831)
  • bind Electron apps by their runtime and name the isolated launch. (#7818) reported by @ymehili.
  • state zero-match get_window_state queries and match a|b alternatives. (#7819) reported by @ymehili.

Contributors

Thanks to @ymehili for contributing to this release.

Install

macOS and Linux:

/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://cua.ai/driver/install.sh)"

Windows:

irm https://cua.ai/driver/install.ps1 | iex

Cua Driver ships universal macOS binaries, x86_64 and arm64 Windows builds, and Linux preview builds. Release assets also include tag-pinned installer and uninstaller scripts.

Why GitHub says “Pre-release”

GitHub's label is used only to keep this monorepo's repository-wide “Latest” pointer from switching between independently released products. A plain Cua Driver SemVer is a stable release; npm and PyPI publish it on their normal stable channels, and the installers resolve the versioned cua-driver-rs-v* releases directly.

v0.5.9-beta.3v0.5.9-beta.3 — VoiceStudio Prerelease2026-11-16T12:05:12Z

Download

Platform Download Signing
Windows x64 Installer ⚠️ Unsigned: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway
Windows ARM64 (experimental) Installer ⚠️ Unsigned: SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC"; choose More info → Run anyway
macOS Apple Silicon DMG ✅ Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple
macOS Intel DMG ✅ Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple
Linux x64 AppImage · deb — Linux packages are not code-signed
Android APK · AAB ✅ Signed APK; the AAB is the Play Store bundle
iPhone Unsigned IPA ⚠️ Unsigned: sign it with your own Apple ID to sideload; not a TestFlight build

Setup and model downloads recover more reliably after interrupted transfers, low-space retries and transient connection failures. This beta also improves low-VRAM generation, pronunciation, long-recording transcription, plain-text exports in Dubbing and Transcriptions, and Android downloads.

Highlights

  • Setup reuses verified wheels and retries transient connection failures; model downloads reject corrupt ranges while preserving valid work
  • Low-VRAM GPUs release idle models before generation
  • Saved pronunciation entries and inline overrides work across speech, Dub, batch and voice conversion
  • Save plain transcripts from Dubbing before or after generation on desktop, or from generated paired-phone results; Transcriptions also exports SRT with genuine cue timings and handles long recordings with duration-scaled limits
  • Android downloads work through eligible VPN routes, and installed gated models open their licence review dialog

Testing wanted: small-GPU generation under memory pressure; pronunciation in Dub, batch and voice conversion; long-file transcription and text/SRT export; edited Dubbing transcripts before generation and paired-phone TXT sharing; low-space or restricted-network setup; interrupted model downloads followed by Retry; and Android downloads with a VPN and cellular opt-in.

Known scope: the low-memory Mac Stories performance report #4090, Stories playback report #4136, legacy Dubbing Method Not Allowed report #4127 and Windows native model-loading crash #4142 remain unresolved. Dubbing TXT export answers the separate plain-transcript request in #4127; it does not repair or establish a retest of the archived v0.3.8 Tauri SRT/405 failure. VoxCPM2 installation report #4150 still needs the original failing step and logs. The playback wording does not fix the underlying Stories failure. Download transport pinning applies to accelerated transfers, rather than all Hub metadata or plain Hugging Face fallback traffic.

Upgrading: install over the existing app or use Settings → Updates → Beta. Voices, projects, settings and installed models stay in place. The release workflow adds the download table from actual desktop and phone artifacts, including measured signing results.

Changed

  • Removed an unused legacy update-busy helper while retaining active restart protection (#4149) — thanks @themrbeasley!
  • Retired an unused legacy update toast while preserving the active Electron update controls (#4141) — thanks @themrbeasley!

Added

  • Dubbing exports the selected transcript as plain UTF-8 TXT, including edited text before generating a dub, with native Save As and paired phone sharing. (#4155) — thanks @shivamdhiman999111-source!

Docs

  • Track the unresolved VoxCPM2 installation report separately from GPU fallback fixes, reported by vinhson (#4154)
  • Document host-managed Tailscale access for Docker without sharing the host daemon socket (#4111) — thanks @MaverickKB!
  • Installation tracking separates shipped fixes, pending repairs and unresolved report evidence (#4121)
  • Track the unresolved Windows model-loading crash and distinguish merged installer repairs from released fixes (#4146) — thanks @renaldyramadani123-code!

Fixed

  • Diagnostic bundles and Electron bug reports redact share PINs and encoded credential query parameters (#4151) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • The reviewed model-install steps now require the same authenticated consumer as the rest of the model manager (#4152) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • macOS publishing checks Gatekeeper even when Windows installers are explicitly unsigned (#4153)
  • Malformed model-install status responses keep the interface open and preserve the last valid download state (#4106) — thanks @ftlcustomerservice73-ui!
  • Auto setup can retry PyPI failures through the regional mirror and report the actual failed host (#4107) — thanks @mrkeshi!
  • Optional analytics no longer delays backend readiness, and consent changes invalidate queued startup work (#4108) — thanks @cf3901646!
  • Update the optional Dagger pipeline's OpenTelemetry dependencies to fix excessive CPU use when parsing malformed trace context. (#4109)
  • URL imports restore their connection guard after temporary DNS resolver changes (#4110)
  • Long recordings use duration-scaled transcription limits across uploads, dubbing, child engines and MCP tools (#4112) — thanks @xabiherdz-svg!
  • Stop cancelled setup retries promptly and keep verbose runtime probes from blocking on their diagnostic output. (#4113)
  • Saved and inline pronunciation choices apply consistently across speech, dubbing, batch and voice-conversion routes (#4114) — thanks @nntloc!
  • Reuse verified setup wheels on low-space retries and handle interrupted size probes without an uncaught error. (#4115)
  • Model downloads reject damaged files and retry without reusing corrupt ranges, while cancellation preserves verified work (#4116)
  • Reclaim idle GPU models before generation when VRAM or RAM is low (#4117) — thanks @vandyahmad24!
  • Crash recurrence reports recognize current Electron version fields and distinguish beta releases (#4120)
  • Model deletion over the API now requires administrator rights (#4122) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • SoniTranslate installation and start/stop now require a local administrator, like every other engine installer (#4123) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Deleting history, rewriting dub scripts and clearing model-licence receipts now require an administrator, as the API docs already promised (#4124) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Imported project bundles can no longer make ffmpeg fetch remote URLs through a playlist-shaped media file (#4125) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • TTS and event WebSockets now enforce the same loopback/credential rule as dictation, closing a share-PIN bypass (#4126) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • MCP tools preserve remote caller permissions across local and HTTP backends, including failed transport lookups (#4128) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Docker deployments now require the administrator API key for the runtime log, log stream, recent errors and crash report, as the install docs already said (#4129) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • A deterministic test now fails when a new mutating API route ships without an authorization decision (#4130) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • The LM Studio model probe no longer sends the stored API key in clear text to a remote host unless plaintext LAN is allowed (#4131) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Segmented model downloads pin public destinations with bounded DNS checks across redirects, ranges and proxies, preventing private-network fallback and CDN credential leaks (#4132) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Cloud sign-in now rejects a discovery document whose token or revocation endpoint is not on the issuer's own origin (#4133) — thanks @DeryFerd!
  • Transcriptions can save clean plain text and timed SRT captions, with an explanation when subtitle timings are unavailable (#4135)
  • Stopped playback errors from incorrectly claiming that generated audio files are missing (#4138) — thanks @AAYUSH-CODER1904!
  • Android model downloads resume through VPNs while preserving Wi-Fi policy and saved ranges (#4140) — thanks @JerryTimi!
  • Make the installed-model licence action open its terms and acknowledgement dialog — thanks hugotriunfa18 on Discord! (#4147)

  • Transcriptions and Dubbing plain-transcript request: @shivamdhiman999111-source; Android VPN report: @JerryTimi; cleanup proposal: @themrbeasley; Windows crash report: @renaldyramadani123-code.

  • Installed-model licence-action report: hugotriunfa18 on Discord, from the original complaint; no GitHub identity is attributed.

An easier path to Android updates ✨

This Android beta update makes it easier to move a GitHub-installed copy of Orca to Google Play for future updates.

  • 📱 Open the right update page: Eligible GitHub installs now open the Google Play listing from the home update card, Settings, and the update-required screen.

Highlights

For GitHub installs: The new routing applies to the current Android app, dev.orca.app. It uses your device's language-region and time-zone settings to detect mainland China. If region detection fails, Orca keeps the GitHub route.

Compatibility & upgrade notes

v1.4.261 Stable2026-11-16T10:30:50Z

Previous release: 1.4.259 — Major performance improvements, automatic cleanup and focused subagent views.

Major performance improvements, Cursor Chat & a customizable + menu ✨

Orca 1.4.261 makes busy Chat workflows more responsive and releases memory from browser pages you haven't used in hours. Cursor joins Chat, and a customizable + menu puts your preferred ways to open tabs within reach.

  • ⚡ Move between busy chats with less waiting: Long conversations load their history in pages, and background replies do less work in the sidebar and hidden chats when you switch conversations.
  • 🌐 Keep browser tabs without keeping every page loaded: Memory Saver frees eligible pages after four hours out of view by default, then reloads them when you return. Sites using session cookies can also keep you signed in across restarts.
  • 🤖 Use Cursor in Chat: Start with the Cursor sign-in on your computer, choose a model, effort and Fast, approve commands, and reopen the conversation later.
  • ➕ Make the + menu yours: Use the gear beside the new icon row to reorder actions, hide unused choices and set shortcuts. Hidden actions remain available through search and their shortcuts.
  • ⌨️ Carry terminal work forward accurately: Copy Context, Fork and Continue preserve spaces drawn by terminal programs. Edit → Paste targets the split pane that actually has focus.

Highlights

  • More room for active work: Memory Saver also applies to browser tabs on an updated orca serve host. Desktop tabs retain their title, history, cookies and saved site data. Settings → Browser lets you change the idle interval or turn Memory Saver off.
  • More agent choices: Antigravity Chat works on Windows, and Pi Chat shows subagents. Ordinary Orca CLI commands avoid Electron startup on supported Macs; macOS 13.4 retains the existing launcher.
  • Workspaces at a glance: Experimental workspace cards show activity, unread results, failures and offline hosts. Choose Classic or Experimental from Workspace options. Agents whose panes are asleep keep showing Done.
  • Phone navigation: The paired phone interface gains desktop project groups and a shared browser preference for chat and terminal links, including Ask each time. On desktop, Take back all returns control of phone-driven browser tabs.

Compatibility & upgrade notes

  • Chat history: Existing chats convert to the new store in the background or when first opened. Original chat files stay in place in this release. After downgrading and upgrading again, chats continued in the older version are recovered; a previously converted conversation can appear beside its newer version as a second chat.
  • Browser reloads: Freed pages reload in place; scroll position and page-only memory can reset. Desktop Memory Saver leaves pages loaded when it detects unsaved edits or cannot safely assess them. Savings depend on which pages qualify.
  • Android: The legacy app directs users to install the new dev.orca.app separately; it cannot update into the new package. This desktop release does not install a phone app.
  • Finished agents: Rows leave workspace cards, the Agents list and dashboard when the process exits or its SSH host disconnects. Sleeping panes retain their Done status.

android-v0.0.66Orca Mobile Android android-v0.0.66 Prerelease2026-11-16T10:21:55Z

Previous release: Android 0.0.65

Open Orca without the Google Play startup block—and keep your place in chat ✨

Android 0.0.66 removes the installer license check that could close Orca when Google Play was disabled or unreachable. Download the APK attached to this release to update the dev.orca.app Android app.

  • 📱 Get past the startup error: This APK no longer carries the check behind “Check that Google Play is enabled on your device,” so that check won't prevent you from opening Orca.
  • 💬 Read several chats without losing your place: Switch away from a transcript and return to the spot you were reading, with opened tool runs kept open. Chats already at the latest message continue following new replies.
  • 🗂️ Find work in familiar project groups: With Group by Project, your phone shows the desktop's nested groups and ordering. Collapsing a group stays in sync between devices.
  • 🔗 Choose where chat and terminal links open: One Settings → Browser → Open links preference covers both workflows. Open links on your phone, in Orca's desktop browser, or choose each time.

Highlights

  • Navigate long replies: Tap the ↑ beneath a chat reply to return to its beginning. Tap ↓ to get back to the latest output. Wrap lines on code blocks now stays selected through streaming and transcript redraws, making long code easier to read on a narrow screen.
  • Keep browsing flexible: Ask each time offers the desktop browser, the phone browser and Copy link. Existing saved browser choices carry over. If a desktop browser tab cannot open, the phone browser handles the link instead.

Compatibility & upgrade notes

  • This release provides a GitHub APK for Android; it does not establish availability on Google Play's public production track or the iOS App Store.
  • Project groups need a paired desktop that supplies group information; older hosts can still show a flat list. Update the paired desktop for host-side improvements listed below.
  • Chat reading positions and opened tool runs are remembered while the chat page remains open, rather than saved permanently across app restarts.

What's Changed

The complete repository change inventory for this Android release follows. It includes desktop and host changes; those require updating the corresponding desktop or server and are not all phone features.

Phone navigation, transcript reading, link handling and Android distribution changes.

Yeachan-Heo/oh-my-codex ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.22.8 Stable2026-11-16T11:00:53Z

oh-my-codex v0.22.8

Summary

This patch release ships critical fixes for team lock recovery and Stop hook stability. The native Stop hook no longer loops on stale team membership locks, preventing Codex API quota exhaustion reported in #4086.

Fixed

  • STOP HOOK STABILITY WITH TEAM LOCK RECOVERY (#4087, #4090): Stop hook now properly detects team_lock_recovery_required errors and terminates cleanly with continue:false instead of looping. Stale team membership locks are correctly identified as terminal stops, preventing indefinite continuation attempts that could exhaust the Codex API quota. Fixes #4086.
    • #4087: Stop hook now halts on team_lock_recovery_required instead of looping indefinitely
    • #4090: Stale team locks properly output as terminal stops to prevent continuation

Compatibility

No breaking API changes. Release-coupled metadata (package.json, package-lock.json, Cargo workspace, and plugin metadata) all report 0.22.8.

Verification

  • Full CI on dev candidate (candidate details recorded in release readiness).
  • PR #4087 and #4090 CI passed on merged heads.

Contributors

Thanks to @Yeachan-Heo for contributing to this release.

ChangeLog.

Upgrading to Slint 1.19.0:

  • Rust: Run cargo update.
  • C++: If you're using FetchContent with CMake, update the GIT_TAG entry in CMakeLists.txt to v1.19.0 or release/1.19 for automatic tracking of 1.19.x releases.
  • Node.js: Run npm update slint-ui to bring your package.json up-to-date.
  • ESP-IDF developers: Run idf.py update-dependencies to bring your idf_component.yml up-to-date.

v4.0.5 Stable2026-11-15T22:11:23Z

last30days v4.0.5

X searches now return the posts people actually engaged with.

  • X keyword searches read X's Latest tab, which is ordered by time. On a busy topic that meant the last few minutes of posts, nearly all with zero engagement. Searches now read the Top tab across the whole 30-day window. On a live check, Taylor Swift went from 13 posts with 1 like in total to 28 posts with 212,731 likes, and Claude Code from 20 likes to 67,837 likes for the same 12 posts.
  • Handle discovery gets better as a side effect. It used to promote whoever happened to post in those few minutes and spend searches on them. It now picks accounts that matter for the topic.
  • Searches of a specific account's posts and mentions still read Latest, so no post in the window is missed.

Coming from 4.0.3? See the 4.0.4 notes for the line-spacing fix to KEY PATTERNS and follow-up suggestions.

What's Changed

  • fix(x): read X's Top tab for topic searches by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1465
  • chore(release): bump version to 4.0.5 by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1466

v4.0.4 Stable2026-11-15T21:36:11Z

last30days v4.0.4

KEY PATTERNS and follow-up suggestions no longer run together into one paragraph.

  • When Claude Code is the host, the report writes its numbered patterns and follow-up lines as plain text, not markdown lists, so links stay readable. Those lines used to sit on consecutive lines, and markdown renderers (T3 Code, the Claude desktop and mobile apps) joined them into one run-on paragraph. Each line now has a blank line after it, so it renders the same everywhere.

v4.0.3 Stable2026-11-15T20:06:29Z

last30days v4.0.3

Techmeme now reads more than its first 10 results.

  • Techmeme's archive search returns 10 headlines per request, so a busy topic only ever showed a sliver of the month. The engine now reads enough pages to fill each depth: up to 16 headlines by default and 30 at deep, all inside the research window. A live Microsoft run went from 10 Techmeme headlines to 16 found and 12 in the report.
  • Setup upgrades your Techmeme helper to 2026.11.1, the first release that can read more pages (printing-press-library #2470). An older helper keeps working on one page, and doctor says so instead of calling it broken.

last30days v4.0.2

Fixes from a Grok Bot run on Microsoft (#1449), measured on the same run before and after:

  • Prediction-market odds are real again. An outcome with an empty order book no longer reports a meaningless midpoint, and a set of mutually exclusive ranges that still adds up to far over 100% is hidden. Microsoft's weekly close went from 46% / 44% / 40% to 14% / 8.5% / 8.0%.
  • Hiring Signals shows different roles under each theme. Themes read the job title, department, and the role's own description, not the company text every posting repeats. Repeated examples on Microsoft went from 3 to 0.
  • The top 8 stories cover more than one event. One story takes at most 3 of the 8 slots, each searched angle gets a slot, and old evidence stays behind current stories. Microsoft's top 8 went from 8 outage stories to the outage plus AI and earnings.
  • Top voices are the accounts people engaged with, not the ones that posted most. A headline reposter with ten zero-like posts no longer outranks the company's own account.
  • Source health tells the truth. A YouTube bot check gets its own advice instead of "upgrade yt-dlp", the host plan no longer adds sources that cannot run, and Techmeme searches only the research window.
  • Company resolution stops getting rate-limited by Wikidata (#1447).

v4.0.0 Stable2026-11-15T16:33:30Z

last30days v4.0.0

Before you upgrade: sidecar cookies now need consent

On Linux, Mac mini, and Darwin sink hosts, the agentcookie sidecar no longer reads X cookies just because it is installed. If you rely on it, set AGENTCOOKIE=on (or an affirmative BROWSER_CONSENT) in ~/.config/last30days/.env. Explicit refusals still win, and direct AUTH_TOKEN + CT0 credentials keep working. /last30days doctor tells you when an installed sidecar needs the opt-in. Thanks to @vincentkoc (#1365, landed in #1440).

What's new

  • Secret Signals in plain words. Patent and jobs signals are two sentences: what the filing or role is, and what it could mean. A patent shows up only when it is out of character for the company or describes a product it hasn't shipped, and the two strongest candidates are checked on the web first (#1427, #1428).
  • Company-run job boards. A company report now reads the company's own careers site, either directly (Amazon, Apple, Google, IBM, Eightfold boards for Microsoft, Qualcomm, and Netflix) or by detecting its hiring platform (Oracle, JPMorgan, Dell, AMD, Adobe, Cisco, Disney, Salesforce, Intel, and others). Sites with only a job sitemap get a titles-only digest. Set LAST30DAYS_JOBS_RESPECT_ROBOTS=1 to honor robots.txt (#1428, #1431).
  • Gemini model pins. A stale LAST30DAYS_PLANNER_MODEL or LAST30DAYS_RERANK_MODEL pin warns and falls back instead of failing, and Gemini 4+ is accepted. Thanks to @SajjadPSavoji (#1430, landed in #1439).
  • Grok Bot run fixes. --as-of set to today is a live run, an outdated Digg helper reports its upgrade command, a missing stock helper is named, and post-write checks no longer delete required sections (#1427).

Contributors

Thank you @vincentkoc and @SajjadPSavoji.

What's Changed

  • fix: show patent signals only when surprising, and fix the Grok Bot run by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1427
  • feat: plain-words Secret Signals and company-run job boards by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1428
  • feat(jobs): read company boards by hiring platform, with a sitemap tier and fall-through by @mvanhorn in https://github.com/mvanhorn/last30days-skill/pull/1431

longbridge/gpui-kit ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v0.10.0 Stable2026-11-16T06:44:25Z

GPUI Kit v0.10.0

GPUI Kit 0.10.0 is a minor release. It moves the optional GPUI Fast backend to 0.1.16, adds global right-to-left layout, an explicit reduced-motion preference, roving keyboard navigation in Tabs, opt-in match highlighting in Select / Combobox / Command, and a long run of input, text, table and accessibility fixes. Two small breaking changes in the input API make this a minor release.

Breaking Changes

  • Textarea: TextareaMode::Extras is now TextareaExtras instead of (). Only code that names this associated type is affected. (#3970)
    - type Extras = ();
+ type Extras = TextareaExtras;
  • Input: EditorState::text_gutter_margin() is replaced by text_origin_offset() -> Option<Pixels>. (#3765)
  • GPUI Fast 0.1.16: every Element now gets IntoElement from GPUI Fast itself. Apps built on the gpui-fast feature must drop their own impl IntoElement for X { type Element = Self; ... } on element types, or they will not compile. The default gpui-pre backend is unchanged.

New APIs

  • Layout: global right-to-left layout direction. (#3886)
  • Motion: an explicit reduced-motion preference. (#3881)
  • Select, Combobox, Command: opt-in highlight_matches, with a new list.highlight.foreground theme color. (#3959, #3960)
  • Input: set_tokens and text decorations on TextareaState, context_menu_offset, and the editor text origin offset. (#3971, #3970, #3920, #3765)
  • Table: TableRow::id, TableRow::hover, and DataTable::scrollbar_mode. (#3907, #3912, #3945)
  • Text: TextView::link to replace or drop links, and an option to keep raw HTML in Markdown as text. (#3743, #3979)
  • Components: Checkbox::indeterminate, SidebarGroup::suffix, NumberInput stepper option, Diff::split_ratio, MessageScroller::scroll_to_offset, SelectableText highlights, and tooltip anchor offsets. (#3980, #3982, #3748, #3883, #3922, #3929, #3874)
  • Locales: Japanese. (#3976)

Editor and text input

  • Move the caret and delete by grapheme cluster; reveal the caret after a long single-line paste; report a preedit kept by unmark_text as a change; keep IME candidates on the matching row. (#3887, #3967, #3965, #3939)
  • Hit-test past the gutter, open completion menus above the caret when they do not fit below, let Copy with no selection reach the window selection, keep the tab indicator inside its tab. (#3921, #3925, #3915, #3983)
  • Textarea: no newline on secondary Enter, and no scrolling at fractional scales while auto-growing. (#3879, #3882)

Markdown and text rendering

  • Fold white space as HTML does, parse <pre> as a code block, lay out several images inline, and number list items correctly after a sub-list. (#3949, #3899, #3898, #3876)
  • Code spans: count oversized insets once per line, keep leading white space beside a fold. (#3972, #3962)
  • Selection: triple click selects a line or wrapped paragraph, drag auto-scroll starts at an edge that hides text, a press on a control keeps the selection, a cursor set on TextView replaces the I-beam. (#3930, #3942, #3928, #3951, #3966, #3927, #3964)

Components

  • Table: no per-frame redraw of a striped table that does not fill its area, and no per-row cross-axis measure. (#3978, #3868)
  • Tooltip: animate width between tooltips, wrap long text within max_w, show one tooltip when nested in a native .tooltip(). (#3957, #3975, #3896, #3914)
  • Diff: keep split columns beside a long line, keep the header in view when switching modes, collapse many files in one rebuild. (#3958, #3884, #3935)
  • Button: spinner on a loading button without icon, no focus on right/middle press, no hover style while disabled. (#3908, #3924, #3943)
  • Select, Popover, Dialog, Dock, Settings, Slider, Attachment, Tabs, Title bar: keep menu height while searching; keep a popover open for clicks in its child popup; offset stacked dialogs by open dialogs only; let the skin size a closed dock; fold the settings page from its title; slider keyboard shortcuts; animated GIF previews; roving Tabs navigation; keep a title-bar click that moves a pixel. (#3944, #3909, #3897, #3931, #3947, #3919, #3903, #3900, #3918)
  • Window, WebView, Theme, Native menu: end mouse gestures when the compositor eats MouseUp, redraw after releasing the composition surface, Windows scrollbar convention, reject bad hex digits instead of panicking, SVG sniffing across a split character. (#3643, #3986, #3895, #3936, #3890)

Accessibility

  • Expose single- and multi-line input text, labels and disabled inputs to assistive technology; numeric SetValue on Slider; a visible label on the copy button; Tab leaves selection controls that become disabled. (#3818, #3894, #3937, #3877, #3963, #3910, #3872, #3875)

Dependencies

  • GPUI Fast 0.1.16; gpui-pre stays at 0.3.12.

Contributors

Build type: RelWithDebInfo
LuaJIT 2.1.1794386141

Release notes

  • Changelog (fixes + features)
  • News (:help news in Nvim)

Install

Windows

Zip

  1. Download nvim-win64.zip (or nvim-win-arm64.zip for ARM)
  2. Extract the zip
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

MSI

  1. Download nvim-win64.msi (or nvim-win-arm64.msi for ARM)
  2. Run the MSI
  3. Run nvim.exe in your terminal

Note: On Windows "Server" you may need to install vcruntime*.dll.

macOS (x86_64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-x86_64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-x86_64/bin/nvim

macOS (arm64)

  1. Download nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Run xattr -c ./nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz (to avoid "unknown developer" warning)
  3. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-macos-arm64.tar.gz
  4. Run ./nvim-macos-arm64/bin/nvim

Linux (x86_64)

If your system does not have the required glibc version, try the (unsupported) builds for older glibc.

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-x86_64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-x86_64/bin/nvim

Linux (arm64)

AppImage

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
  2. Run chmod u+x nvim-linux-arm64.appimage && ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage
    • If your system does not have FUSE you can extract the appimage:
      ./nvim-linux-arm64.appimage --appimage-extract
./squashfs-root/usr/bin/nvim

Tarball

  1. Download nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz
  2. Extract: tar xzvf nvim-linux-arm64.tar.gz
  3. Run ./nvim-linux-arm64/bin/nvim

Other

  • Install by package manager

v2026.11.5-beta.4openclaw 2026.11.5-beta.4 Prerelease2026-11-16T03:12:26Z

2026.11.5-beta.4

Highlights

Changes

  • Telegram widgets: Render interactive widgets as Telegram messages (#196991) Thanks @obviyus.

Fixes

  • Transcripts and attachments: Keep transcript reads available during concurrent database preparation, release completed SQLite readers without restarting cursors, and avoid inserting binary attachments into model prompts (#188055, #190242, #198309, #198289) Thanks @jalehman, @vincentkoc, @ava-perry, @Yun-0000, @obviyus, and @mulderp82.
  • Automation continuity: Deliver failed-child results after parent turns end, run late scheduled jobs correctly, preserve in-flight jobs across config changes, and let repair turns inspect their jobs (#197658, #197484, #197606, #197591, #188105) Thanks @obviyus, @vincentkoc, @RomneyDa, @Stronggenetics, and @wupingyuan81-oss.
  • Automation privacy: Recheck owner-private memory access when queued automation runs start (#198697, #198695) Thanks @daniel-lxs.
  • Claude and approvals: Recover after CLI cleanup failures, preserve paired-node Gateway context, relay approvals across differing tool-call IDs, and allow configured-primary fallback (#198224, #195431, #145741, #145636, #197853, #197829, #198427, #158421) Thanks @obviyus, @mdarapour, @ZengWen-DT, @bricelb, @gulagala001, @Borekobama, @alkor2000, and @HerbertHuerto.
  • Provider recovery: Recover OpenAI conversations from compaction item conflicts and saved-context hook overrides, retry newer Claude models with a compatible OAuth client version, and keep OpenRouter requests on their endpoint (#198357, #199451, #196693, #185294, #185272) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vyctorbrzezowski, @obviyus, and @vishnusenthil-16.
  • Update safety: Retry installation discovery, retain run watching across ledger failures, keep plugin lifecycle leases alive during finalization, roll back releases that fail Doctor or startup, and handle moved cron partitions (#188010, #188015, #188404, #197851, #185097) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @vincentkoc, @obviyus, and @RomneyDa.
  • Large session memory: Export memory in bounded pages, finish large-index rebuilds after updates, and avoid unnecessary transcript allocation for native context seeds (#196158, #196132, #196480, #196378, #194545) Thanks @RomneyDa, @vincentkoc, @ericcaiwx-star, @obviyus, and @garrytan.
  • Telegram: Deliver inline button taps, keep disabled buttons inactive, preserve topics for approvals and widgets, and include runtime session keys in message hooks (#196217, #126950, #191647, #191645, #198038, #197907, #192162, #125166, #198022, #197923, #197519, #197186, #197669) Thanks @goslingmanagment, @dmsrg399, @obviyus, @kkernan, @aspalagin, @dankarization, @claxman, @Waste2Time, @lester076, @rodricksz4h5, and @tommyjoseph.
  • Mobile and voice: Deliver captioned Feishu media when block streaming is disabled, avoid the iOS speech-permission crash, and start backing agents for Talk requests (#191585, #196822, #183586) Thanks @forrystudio, @obviyus, @bdjben, and @brokemac79.
  • Control UI: Prevent retained loading animations from slowing repeated session switches, avoid WebKit picker/menu freezes, and handle chat Details updates without listener errors (#194027, #194146, #198658, #198380) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @fuller-stack-dev.
  • Gateway resilience: Bound Matrix formatted-message mention parsing, cancel pending MCP listener work during shutdown, and restore Bonjour discovery in npm installations (#184432, #197119, #199156) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @LeizhenZhang, @obviyus, @zeroaltitude, and @alfredjbclaw.
  • Database recovery and backups: Compact backups inside staging, inspect engines without copying live databases, preserve corruption diagnostics, avoid repeated report rewrites, restore renamed-agent cold transcripts, and isolate retained or held agent databases without blocking startup (#194230, #194208, #194234, #194209, #194497, #194636, #194621, #196079, #196066, #198145, #190875, #190918, #198180) Authored by @steipete. Thanks @GoatInAHat, @wr-web, @sennyhoney, @chrislro, and @Frosmans.
  • Model selection: Avoid slow model reads with many configured models (#198837) Thanks @vincentkoc.
  • Automation chat bindings: Keep stored automations attached to conversations through edits, branches, and resets, while visibly refusing delivery to closed chats. Thanks @obviyus, @vincentkoc, and @RomneyDa.
  • Compaction memory: Bound summary payload ownership and release source data before summaries finish so concurrent sessions do not retain entire transcripts. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.
  • Rescue diagnostics: Return completed rescue-command findings instead of losing their output. Thanks @wr-web, @RomneyDa, and @vincentkoc.
  • Memory export completion: Settle streamed export observers after source validation. Thanks @RomneyDa and @vincentkoc.

Complete contribution record

This audited record covers the complete v2026.11.5-beta.3..8649a8f54001e1e88869f83204db54dd9870b8f3 history: 55 in-range PRs + 0 retained seed-only PRs = 55 unique PRs. The generation manifest also supplies direct commits as editorial input; the grouped notes above prioritize user impact.

HyperFrames v0.9.56

Released on 2026-11-16.

Studio's preview and the local servers now act only for their own pages. The CLI keeps its cache, history and restores inside the project. The arm64 Lambda image ships only the reviewed ffmpeg build, and large previews build faster.

Fixes

  • Studio Server: The composition file servers no longer serve credential or tool-state files (014326b40, #7889).
  • Studio Server: Lint and probe run only for requests from Studio's own pages (bbac8900e, #7894).
  • Studio Server: A history restore stays inside the project and uses only intact copies (478313ba0, #7902).
  • Studio: Take playback works for a preview its server made opaque (1e542956d, #7815).
  • Studio: The preview frame keeps the sandbox origin its host set (b650d0d19, #7886).
  • Studio: Present decks open only in their own site, and the preview reads only its own frame's messages (4067efc45, #7877).
  • Core: The runtime bridge checks each control message before acting on it (97d8f26e7, #7892).
  • CLI: render --docker keeps the host's page-network restriction inside the container (5d8605eb8, #7890).
  • CLI: preview --stop stops only the process the system reports holding the port (ace8a78dc, #7882).
  • CLI: The check cache is saved only as a project record, never through a linked file (7801e3ff3, #7884).
  • CLI: History turn ids read from the project folder are checked and sent encoded (6efa6b635, #7883).
  • CLI: Catch-up lists only the turns the app added after the hand-off (0f23f40f8, #7874).
  • CLI: A received-files record in a folder under the project counts for a render (1c159c550, #7900).
  • CLI: Media-use copies only the sound effects its bundled index names (ed93a1312, #7895).
  • Media Use: Local models start from a folder outside the project (756c2c6c1, #7888).
  • Engine: A cached browser is used only when its files match the pinned build (56a2d0c53, #7865).
  • Engine: Timeline frame predictions stay within the render's frames (f5a74a567, #7885).
  • Engine: Each superset extraction works in a folder of its own (a4139e9ea, #7901).
  • Parsers: Reading a canvas scaffold's width and height takes the same short time on any input (b856a1d63, #7873).
  • Lint: Agent-made scenes and sound effects stay on one timeline lane (98208241e, #7775).
  • Skills: Standalone installs run the CLI through its launcher too (3fc3050bc, #7879).
  • AWS Lambda: A release ships the arm64 ffmpeg only when it matches the digest committed beside its build (d9488119b, #7872).

Performance

  • Core: A preview build reads a large page without copying it on every pass (082d63683, #7878).
  • Producer: Compile and render-telemetry tag scans take time in step with the page's size (82fdf406c, #7896).

Internal

  • Publish: Every npm publish waits on the npm-publish approval (a54de748e, #7870).
  • Publish: Prebuilt tarballs publish from a job that runs no code from the release commit (af0560c85, #7869).
  • CI: Publishing workflows run only for main (7bd6b9daf, #7875).
  • CI: Test fixtures no longer look like real HeyGen keys, and CI rejects one that does (5dc3b336a, #7876).

farion1231/cc-switch ↗ 1 release · 1 stable
v4.0.33CC Switch v4.0.33 Stable2026-11-16T02:28:11Z

CC Switch v4.0.33

本版本修复了从第三方供应商切回 Claude 官方后，已经开着的 Claude Code 会话仍把请求发给上一家、要重开会话才恢复的问题。套餐额度查询新增 Ollama Cloud；授权中心的 Antigravity 账号切换现在也支持 Windows。

另外修复了 Claude Code / Claude Desktop 的供应商选 Gemini Native 格式时获取模型列表总报「API Key 无效或无权限」；部分服务商获取模型列表被 Cloudflare 拦下；Antigravity Orchestrator 仍有部分请求显示未定价；WebDAV 同步在一些 NAS 上完全用不了；WebDAV / S3 上传失败只显示「请求构造失败」；查询 xAI 额度时遇到网络抖动就被要求重新登录；更新 Skill 中途失败把原来的 Skill 删掉等问题。

English → | 日本語版 →

新增

Ollama Cloud 套餐额度

地址是 ollama.com 的供应商现在可以查询 Token Plan 额度（需求见 #9382）：现行套餐显示本期套餐内额度的剩余比例和重置时间，旧版套餐显示 5 小时和每周两个窗口的剩余比例。单独购买的额度不显示；按量付费的账号没有套餐额度，会说明原因。本机运行的 Ollama（localhost:11434）没有套餐，不会被识别。

  • 新添加或一键导入的 Ollama Cloud 供应商默认开启额度查询；已有的供应商在卡片上点「配置用量查询」，Token Plan 模板会自动选好，打开「启用用量查询」后保存即可。

Windows 上切换 Antigravity 账号

授权中心的 Antigravity 账号切换以前只支持 macOS，现在 Windows 也能用：切换后 agy 读到的是新账号，Antigravity 官方卡可以绑定账号、查看所绑账号的额度，打开终端前也会提示将切换到哪个账号。Linux 暂不支持。

修复

  • 从第三方供应商切回 Claude 官方后，已经开着的 Claude Code 会话仍把请求发给上一家，要重开会话才恢复（#9247，见 #7808、#3057）：运行中的 Claude Code 只会读入 settings.json 里新增和改动的环境变量，被删掉的仍留在会话里。现在切换时先把要删的地址、凭据和模型映射写成空值，开着的会话下一条请求就不再用上一家，约 10 秒后再从文件里删掉。会话启动时就定下的主模型（ANTHROPIC_MODEL）不会跟着变：如果上一家设了它，切回后在模型菜单里选一次 Default，或者新开会话。
  • Claude Code / Claude Desktop 的供应商选 Gemini Native 格式时，「获取模型列表」总是报「API Key 无效或无权限」：现在按 Google 要求的方式传 Key。经路由的实际请求本来就正常，只有获取模型列表受影响。另外，Pi、Oh My Pi、Kimi Code 选 Google 接口的供应商，获取模型列表以前最多只列出 50 个，现在能列全。
  • 获取模型列表时，部分放在 Cloudflare 后面的服务商直接拒绝，被误报为「API Key 无效或无权限」（#7429，见 #7427）：请求现在默认带上 User-Agent；供应商或请求头里设了 User-Agent 的，仍以设置的为准。
  • Antigravity 选 Orchestrator 时，仍有部分请求显示未定价（#9542，见 #9493）：显示为「Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Orchestrator)」的步骤按 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 的价格计价，近 30 天内的历史也会补上费用。自定义价格仍然优先。
  • WebDAV 同步在部分 NAS 上完全用不了，测试连接、上传、下载都失败（#5623，见 #5621）：这些 NAS 在共享文件夹已存在时仍对「建目录」回 400，以前会直接中止，现在会再查一次目录是否存在。
  • WebDAV / S3 上传被服务器中途断开时，只显示「请求构造失败」（见 #9559）：现在分清是请求没构造出来还是发送时失败，并附上具体原因，方便判断是网络、TLS 还是服务器的问题。地址里的密码和签名参数不会出现在报错里。
  • S3 自动同步在关掉之后仍可能再上传一次（#9528）：另一次同步进行中时排队的自动上传，现在开始前会重新读取设置，期间关掉了自动同步或 S3 同步就不再上传。WebDAV 本来就是这样。
  • 查询 xAI 账号额度时，遇到网络抖动或 xAI 服务出错就提示需要重新登录（#9526，见 #9522）：只有登录真的失效才这样提示，临时错误照常报错并保留上次查到的额度，下次查询再试。
  • 一个非默认的 xAI 账号过期后，授权中心里选好的默认账号被换成了别的账号（#9548，见 #9543）。
  • 更新 Skill 时如果复制到一半失败，原来的 Skill 被删掉，列表里却仍显示已安装（见 #9521）：现在新版本完整复制好之后才替换，失败时保留原来的版本。
  • Codex 经路由转成 Chat 格式时，工具定义里的 required: null 被要求严格的上游拒绝（#7023，见 #7019）。
  • macOS / Linux 上 shell 配置文件的路径里带冒号时，「检测到系统环境变量冲突」删除或恢复变量会失败（#7170，见 #7169）。
  • PIPELLM、AICodeWith、E-FlowCode 的 Pi 预设在模型选择里显示成旧模型名（#9514）：比如 Claude Opus 5.5 显示成 claude-opus-5，实际请求的是新模型。用这几个预设生成的 DeepSeek Harness、Copilot CLI、Oh My Pi、MiniMax Code、Kimi Code 预设一起修正；已经添加的供应商保留原来保存的名字。
  • 地址形如 api.commandcode.ai/providers 的供应商被当成 Command Code 套餐查询额度（#9518）。

致谢

感谢 @funkpopo（切回 Claude 官方后开着的会话跟着切换，以及语言列表集中管理）、@ziyangxiami（Hydrogen Orchestrator 计价）、@SailingLoong（获取模型列表的 User-Agent）、@stofancy（WebDAV 兼容 NAS）、@HaiYangBG1（xAI 账号的两处修复、Skill 更新失败时保留原版本）、@GalaxyKW（Codex 工具定义的 required）、@cuishuang（环境变量路径里的冒号）、@SaladDay（Pi 预设模型名、Command Code 地址识别、S3 自动同步，以及 WebDAV 与 S3 同步代码合并、语言列表集中管理、前后端常量比对等内部整理）的贡献。

感谢 @Lawgk、@eDramas、@xinluke、@JImmyHui2017、@liuxixiang11、@WindowsXP-PLUS 报告问题和提供复现信息。

完整的技术细节请见 CHANGELOG。
